messages:
jin: Opening a small PR to switch three examples to the new structured-output envelope: order-cancel, calendar-invite, embeddings-rerank. PR #4512. Need quick docs + SDK snippet updates.

rachel: Thanks. Please include before/after fenced blocks for each snippet in the PR description so docs-bot doesn't block merge.

sam: I'll take calendar-invite. Which file to edit?

jin: docs/examples/flows/calendar-invite.md. Also update docs/guides/tool-calling.md reference.

kevin: I'll add tiny parse helpers (JS/Python) in sdk/examples/parse_helpers and a note to validate with the provided JSON Schema. Suggested JS fallback:
```js
function safeParse(text){try{return JSON.parse(text);}catch(e){const m=text.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);return m?JSON.parse(m[0]):null;}}
```

legal-bot: ATTENTION: embeddings snippet derived from external gist. Add attribution comment and confirm license compatibility.

rachel: Also add two smoke tests in docs-tests that assert our schema validator accepts the example outputs. Keeps regressions out of main branch.

jin: Will add tests, redirects for old anchors, and a one-line migration blurb in docs/migration/tool-calls.md. Checklist in PR: (1) schema; (2) examples; (3) SDK helpers; (4) tests; (5) redirects; (6) legal attribution.

sam: Ping me when CI preview is up and I'll start review.

jin: Preview will be attached to the PR. Thanks all :thumbsup:
